title: Number of provinces
statement: An n × n adjacency matrix says which cities are directly connected (symmetric, ones on the diagonal). A province is a connected group of cities. Return the number of provinces.
hints: Start with n components; every union of two different roots reduces the count by one.

solution.explanation: Union-find counts components incrementally: n singletons, minus one per successful union. DFS works equally well here; union-find shines when edges arrive online or when you also need "are x and y connected?" queries.
